# atlassian_jira_project_permission_scheme (Resource)

Attach a permission scheme to a Jira project. One project can have only one permission scheme; attaching a different scheme replaces it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_key` (String) Project key or ID (e.g. PROJ or 10000).
- `scheme_id` (String) Permission scheme ID to assign to the project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID: project_key (same as project_key for convenience).
